dog.description_text:
World meet Marta!! This girl is the definition of a forever puppy, in looks and energy! Along with her sister, Kylian (they are a package deal), Marta is learning how to be a dog for the first time while in foster care. It appears she may never have been outside before, so everything is brand new to her, but she's taking it all in stride! She's still very nervous compared to your average dog, but is doing better every day. She is working on her potty training, and has so far only gone pee in our yard once and on a walk once, but that's progress! Her and her sister (that relationship has not yet been confirmed) have an incredible bond and love to spend every day cuddled up, playing, or napping with you. She will make an amazing dog for someone willing to put in the work she and Kylian will require to gain confidence, but we know they'll both get there with time!

﻿Marta (Bonded to Kylian) is approximately 1y 9m 13d old and is fully grown at 10 pounds. They are microchipped and up to date on all age-appropriate medical care. Their breed is unknown as we have not had a DNA test done.

Although our dogs are listed as unknown breed, buildings with specific dog restrictions typically enforce their rules based on what breeds a dog appears to resemble. It's always important to keep that in mind and know your building's policies before adopting a dog.

This dog is available for adoption through Muddy Paws Rescue. If you're interested in adopting, the first thing you should do is begin the registration process at www.muddypawsrescue.org. If you are already a registered adopter with Muddy Paws Rescue, please email us at adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org.
